digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and code-review scope extraction
propositions: Heading-reading code in gates.py, det_floor.py, and assemble.py currently keys on '## Success Criteria' but should be repointed to '## Acceptance Criteria' to unify criteria vocabulary.
Test fixtures across lifecycle, store, and unit tests embed '## Success Criteria' headings that must be migrated to '## Acceptance Criteria' or removed entirely.

Repointing the epic branch bonus from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria in _clarity_score keeps the clarity score neutral (6) while making the bonus automatic, since AC is already a universal blocking floor.
The two _clarity_score implementations in gates.py and det_floor.py must remain textually in lockstep to preserve the invariant their comments assert.
A new contract test must prove that epics carrying '## Acceptance Criteria' and '## Context' pass both clarity-check and check-ac, and that _clarity_score(fixture, 'epic') equals 6.
